name: icecream-tracker
description: Ice cream debt tracker API (Cloudflare Worker + D1)

scripts.logs: wrangler d1 execute icecream --remote --command "SELECT datetime(at/1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours') AS karachi_time, who, action, status, detail FROM activity_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100"
scripts.db:init: wrangler d1 execute icecream --local --file schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute icecream --local --file seed.sql
scripts.db:reset: wrangler d1 execute icecream --local --command "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS events; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS shops; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS milestones; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS settings; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS pin_attempts; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS opens; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS push_subs; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS posts; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS post_reactions; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS post_comments; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS game_scores; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS game_months;" && npm run db:init
